explanation.what_it_is: The Anthropic API now returns 429 (rate_limit_error) errors when it hits acceleration limits due to a sharp increase in API usage, replacing the previous 529 (overloaded_error) errors.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change affects how Claude Code users handle rate limiting, as they will now receive more specific error messages when they exceed the API's acceleration limits.
how_to_use: Check API usage patterns to anticipate when rate limits might be exceeded
Implement retry logic to handle 429 errors and prevent failed requests

items.summary: Search result content blocks are now generally available on the Claude API and Google Cloud's Vertex AI. This feature enables natural citations for RAG applications with proper source attribution.…

explanation.what_it_is: Search result content blocks are now available on the Claude API and Google Cloud's Vertex AI, enabling natural citations for RAG applications with proper source attribution.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to access search result content blocks with proper source attribution, making it easier to integrate reliable information into their RAG applications.
how_to_use: Use the Claude API to retrieve search result content blocks with attributed sources
Integrate search result content blocks into RAG applications on Google Cloud's Vertex AI for more accurate and trustworthy outputs

items.title: We've launched Claude Opus 4.1, an incremental update to Claude Opus 4 with…
items.summary: We've launched Claude Opus 4.1, an incremental update to Claude Opus 4 with enhanced capabilities and performance improvements.* Learn more in Models overview.

explanation.what_it_is: Claude Opus 4.1 is an incremental update to the existing Claude Opus 4 model, featuring enhanced capabilities and performance improvements.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update brings improved performance to Claude Code users, potentially leading to more efficient and accurate results in their workflows.
how_to_use: Use the updated model by selecting Claude Opus 4.1 in the Models overview section of the Anthropic API developer platform
